headline: Guillermo del Toro co-wrote a Jabba the Hutt movie
post:
Guillermo del Toro recently stated on X that he is not currently in talks with any Star Wars or Marvel properties in any capacity. 🎬

He did reveal, however, that he previously co-wrote a script with David Goyer for an unmade film titled The Rise and Fall of Jabba the Hutt.

Would you have wanted to see his Jabba the Hutt movie happen, or are you glad he is focusing on his own scripts and stop-motion projects instead?

headline: Dan Mora reveals six member Absolute Justice team
post:
Get ready for a brand-new spin on DC's premiere superhero team! According to Screen Rant, artist Dan Mora recently shared his vibrant cover for the upcoming "Absolute Justice #1," giving us our very first official look at the six-member lineup. Written by Jason Aaron with art by Juan Ferreyra, this exciting five-issue miniseries arrives in March 2027.

This gritty alternate roster features Bruce Wayne, Diana of the Wild Isle, Kal-El, John Jones and Martian Manhunter counting as one hero, Wally West, and Jo Mullein. While the traditional team usually boasts seven members, shaking up the founding roster is always a fascinating move for the DC Universe.

Following the massive success of solo titles like "Absolute Batman," this new alliance is ready to take on harsh odds and potential clashes against Darkseid. Could this thrilling event eventually evolve into a long-running series? 🦸‍♂️

#JusticeLeague #DCComics #DanMora
original_title: DC Reveals New Official Look At Next Justice League Project

headline: Blade director cast actors without scripts
post:
Bassam Tariq revealed he started casting for Marvel's scrapped Blade reboot without a proper script in place. The former director explained that explaining roles to actors who just had to believe him felt dangerous to his credibility.

He learned that life is too short to make poor films and now prefers full control over his scripts. Mahershala Ali later agreed that the failed project is Kevin Feige's biggest career failure.

Would you prefer a studio rush a movie into production or wait years for a finished script? 🧛‍♂️🎬💥

#Blade #Marvel #MCU
original_title: Bassam Tariq Says Marvel’s Scrapped ‘Blade’ Reboot Taught Him “Life’s Too Short to Make Sh** Films”

headline: Marvel Names Peter Parker's Giant Spider Form
post:
Marvel has officially revealed the name of Peter Parker's terrifying new monster form following a grotesque metamorphosis. According to Screen Rant, after getting infected by corrupting blood while protecting Dani, Peter transforms into a building-sized black-and-crimson creature. This nightmarish new entity is officially called "The Arthropod". 

In this shocking state, Peter's limp human body hangs helplessly right from the giant spider's underside while his body acts as the egg it sprouts from. Fortunately, this horrifying transformation is temporary, and Peter eventually gets his original body back. Meanwhile, over in the Midnight Universe, an eighteen-year-old Peter Parker faces a completely different kind of body horror with a permanent spider-shaped growth embedded in his chest.

Which of Spider-Man's monstrous transformations do you prefer?

#SpiderMan #MarvelComics #TheArthropod
original_title: Marvel Officially Announces Name Of New Spider-Man Replacement
